summary: Agility Robotics (formerly Churchill Capital Corp XI, a Cayman SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting completion on November 4, 2026 of its previously announced June 24, 2026 business combination, in which the SPAC merged with Legacy Agility via BLB Merger Sub and was renamed Agility Robotics, Inc., now trading on Nasdaq under AGLT/AGLTW. The filing spans Items 1.01, 2.01, 3.02, 3.03, 4.01, 5.01, 5.02, 5.03, 5.05, 5.06, 8.01 and 9.01, including changes in control, director/officer appointments, charter amendments and shell-company status termination. No per-share price, premium, redemption levels or advisory fees appear in the excerpt. Watch post-declassification lock-up expiries, warrant overhang at $11.50 and redemption-driven float.
